sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost pressures and the approval constraints within your group; we understand that larger price steps require committee approval and that price cuts are currently frozen. The binding volume commitment is set out immediately below, and we can offer a long contract term to support your planning. Could you consider improving the other terms of your proposal?

We confirm a binding volume of 4580 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

We acknowledge your should-cost estimate and appreciate the confirmed volume of 4580 units for a 36-month term. While our group policy currently restricts direct price reductions, the extended contract duration allows us to offer a revised price of EUR 432.15 per unit. We cannot accept 90 days for payment, but we are prepared to agree to 60 days net as a compromise. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.68 per unit, alongside a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
